name: gearbox
description: Picks model and effort for each subagent with Laya, a local decision model, and shows every subagent in a pane with its model, effort, tokens and files. Observes by default (logs its pick and how the agent ended, /gearbox report sums it up); in apply mode it starts subagents on the model it picks

ollama.title: Ollama executable
ollama.description: Path to the ollama executable. A desktop app may not see your shell's PATH: give the full path then, for example /opt/homebrew/bin/ollama.

model.title: Laya model
model.description: The name of the Laya model in Ollama.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe: log what gearbox would pick and change nothing. apply: start each subagent on the model gearbox picks, unless the caller named one. The effort is only recommended either way.

retentionDays.title: Keep logs (days)
retentionDays.description: Logs of other sessions older than this are removed at the start of a session. 0 keeps them all.
